'''''Reep''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The transport was present at a Rebel summit in the [[Delfii system/Legends|Delfii system]], carrying [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]].
